notes.title: Halloween boss Spooky Dooky added!
notes.content:
Welcome back fellow plungers. Plunger Simulator is getting an all new Halloween update featuring a new 
boss battle with the mysterious Spooky Dooky. Dooky will haunt you and try to stop you from unclogging the toilet, a foul plan indeed.  Watch his eyes so you know when to stop plunging. With a new level comes a new collectible turd as well. Also in the update is more room in the collection shed for more collectible turds in the future. Any way best get to plunging!

notes.title: Plunger simulator lore added through collectible turds
notes.content: Hello fellow plungers! Another crazy update has been added. In case you didn't catch the last one, I updated the boss level a bit to look cooler and added some ending text as well. Now with the new update, miniature poops are running around the restaurants, dancing mysteriously. Catch these poops to add them to your collection, where you can watch their best dances as well as learn about their origins. Their is at least 8 poops, some more difficult to find than others. Also in this update are a few bug fixes and extra user interface stuff for some parts of the game. Anyway, best get to plunging and turd collecting. Comment below to let us know your favorite turds.

notes.title: Fixed boss level not able to leave and added ending text
notes.content: Added ending text to explain what's going on, made a retry button for boss battle as well as a little window telling how to beat him. Also added it so poop falls in toilet at end.

notes.title: Beat the Turd Boss, Roy D
notes.content: Hello fellow plungers! The new update for plunger simulator has been released in which you'll have to battle the biggest poop of them all Roy D. However Roy isn't easily found, so you'll have to find him. Also included in the new update is music, which you can turn off and on by pressing M. The gas station was also updated by making it more relatable with a burning surprise. Any way best get to plunging toilets.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41065094/991a394573d334ed160fa10630e3993b55f76217.png[/img]

notes.title: New Level!
notes.content: New update includes new level gas Station. Stay tuned for more updates in the future.
